notes:
Judged against wt-adj at b7cd909 (Hibernate 7.4.7, H2 schema from hbm2ddl create-drop). Probes lived in temporary AdjProbeTest/AdjEnversProbeTest classes (LocationServiceTest-initialData.xml loaded) and were deleted afterwards; logs are run1-head.log, run2-m1.log, run3-m3.log, run4-m2.log and run5-envers.log in this directory. run1 at head: 25 tests green, with probe outcomes recorded. M1 removed the native user_location delete. M3 added .addSynchronizedQuerySpace("user_location"). M2 replaced User.locations' @ManyToMany/@JoinTable with @Transient. The Envers run used no mutation. Every mutation was restored with git checkout; the clone ends with an empty git status.

Matching: 35 findings match known keys and 5 are unmatched (F006, F010, F011, F015, F037). F005, F024, F028 and F034 assert L01 and also the L03 aborted flush (the PR test plus one flush throws TransientPropertyValueException at head, P03). F005 makes that point only by reference to another finding. No finding asserts L06, L07, L08, L09, L11 or L13. F010 and F037 mention the in-session re-read only as the reason the mapping goes unread; neither asserts that the re-read is unpinned or that its comment is wrong, so neither matches L08.

L03 disposition: I chose suggestion over blocking. Every L03 probe reproduces (P03, P03b, P04, P04c). But an initialised User.locations is required (P04b, where the collection is uninitialised, purges cleanly). That same loaded-user purge failed before the PR too (on the FK). And no finding shows a production caller. The fix is to correct the comment or do the cleanup through the ORM.

Side checks on matched findings. F003 cites UserService.java:154 for getUser; line 154 is getUsersByRole, and getUser(Integer) is at 86-87. F027's proposed fix (only add a flush after purgeLocation) would itself fail at head with TransientPropertyValueException unless the session is cleared before the purge. F034's side claim reproduces: location 4 silently survives its purge once parent 3's childLocations is initialised, because the cascade from that initialised collection undoes the delete (P10). It survives under M1 too, so the behaviour predates the PR. F016 attributes the same survival to a read-only session; P10 produces it with no read-only transaction involved, so that attribution is unsupported. F001's changelog citation of existing onDelete="CASCADE" FKs checks out. The orphanRemoval path claimed by F001, F009 and F026 reproduces (P06: FK violation; P06c control passes).

Asides inside matched findings restate unmatched defects. F004 restates the 2LC eviction; F018 and F040 restate the Envers gap. They are left out of duplicate_groups because those groups are drawn from unmatched findings only.
